fixture_selection: Original experiment, voltage probe, eye declaration and transient graph for DDR_SWITCHING / DQ0_RX, in source order. All fields and every sample are retained; unrelated board and simulation records are omitted.
pipeline_archive_note: The repository rename changes the GitHub tarball checksum. All 57 files were verified against the pinned Git blob hashes before refreshing that archive checksum in the generation checkout.
simulation_model: AM335x DQ0 to Winbond DDR3 receiver, 1.5 V, 400 MT/s, fixed repeating 00010111 data, switching DQS neighbors. Historical straightened-stage approximation with assumed 0.75 mm spacing and finite return strips.
result_note: Fresh native run of the source example, compared with its published eye. The fixture demonstrates recorded results of the historical strip approximation; it does not establish routed DDR accuracy, hardware validation or compliance.
